categories.main_business_segments: Sinopec Shanghai Petrochemical Company Limited operates primarily in three business segments: petroleum products, chemical products, and trading of petrochemical products. The petroleum products segment involves refining crude oil into gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, and other fuels. The chemical products segment produces p-xylene, benzene, ethylene oxide, polyethylene and polypropylene resins, acrylic fibers, and carbon fibers. The trading segment focuses on the import and export of petrochemical products. Other minor business activities include investment property leasing and service provision.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses integrated refinery and petrochemical processing technologies to convert crude oil into a wide range of petroleum and chemical products. It operates crude oil distillation facilities and petrochemical processing plants. The company emphasizes refining and chemical integration, product mix optimization, and continuous improvement in production technology to enhance resource utilization efficiency. It also invests in research and development through dedicated institutes focusing on advanced materials, synthetic materials, and environmental protection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves customers within the People's Republic of China, especially in Eastern China, which is a fast-growing economic region. Its products are used in transportation fuels, agricultural machinery, textiles, plastics, consumer electronics, automobile parts, and fine chemicals industries. The company also engages in import and export trade of petrochemical products, serving both domestic and overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: Sinopec Shanghai Petrochemical Company Limited operates mainly in Mainland China, with its production facilities located in Jinshanwei, southwest Shanghai. The company sells most of its products domestically, particularly in Eastern China. It is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, with some overseas trading activities. The company also maintains a principal place of business in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the petrochemical supply chain. It processes crude oil (upstream raw material) into refined petroleum products and chemical intermediates, which are further processed into finished chemical products. It also engages in trading activities, importing and exporting petrochemical products, and provides ancillary logistics and transportation services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on transformation from oil refining to chemical industry, then to materials and high-end products, with an ecological park development approach. It prioritizes innovation-driven development, including new technologies and processes for refining and chemical transformation, fine chemicals, high-end new materials, and carbon fiber projects. The company emphasizes green and low-carbon transformation, operational efficiency, digital and intelligent transformation, and talent development to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of petroleum products, chemical products, and trading of petrochemical products. Sales are recognized primarily at a point in time, with some revenue recognized over time for specific products. The company also earns income from investment properties and government grants. Its revenue streams are largely transactional, based on product sales to domestic and international customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As one of the major integrated petrochemical enterprises in China, the company holds a competitive position due to its large scale, integrated refinery and petrochemical capacity, and strategic location in the Yangtze River Delta. It competes with other large petrochemical and refining companies in China and globally. Its competitive advantages include product quality, geographic proximity to key markets, integrated production, and comprehensive logistics capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported operating income of approximately RMB 87.13 billion in 2024, with a net profit attributable to equity shareholders of RMB 316.5 million under CAS and RMB 310.98 million under IFRS. Total assets were about RMB 41.77 billion, and equity attributable to shareholders was approximately RMB 25.04 billion. The company experienced a revenue decline of 6.32% year-on-year in 2024 but returned to profitability after previous losses. It maintains a gearing ratio of about 39.8%, indicating moderate leverage.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated refinery and petrochemical capacity, enabling efficient production and product quality. Its strategic location in the economically active Yangtze River Delta provides logistical advantages and proximity to customers. The company focuses on product mix optimization, quality improvement, and development of new high-end chemical products and materials. It also highlights its commitment to green and low-carbon transformation, operational excellence, and innovation-driven growth as key differentiators.
